title: Repository conformity, reuse, and dead-code hardening
runbook_section: LIVE / Repository conformity and removal audit
note: Close evidence, safety, architecture, quality-gate, dependency, and dead-code drift without racing the active Parquet production tracks or deleting historical/migration evidence by static scan.

external_dependencies.for: CLI, parquet_ops, and pyproject ownership may pass to conformity only after the completed s2a tree is frozen; the delegated direct-writer scope remains outside this track.
useViewportProxiedLayers.ts and the coverage/snapshot reader subset of parquet_ops may pass to conformity only after the production zoom, availability and request contracts are frozen.
All Drizzle edits remain owned by shrink s6; conformity records dormant-migration evidence without editing migration files.

shared_writes: Reader, capability, climate-rung and fire-route files remain owned by parquet_reader_cutover_acceptance_20260901 and multiscale_polygon_surface_20260901.
Writer-service and scheduler handoff configuration remains owned by gapless_parquet_publication_20260901.
This track may inventory those surfaces but may edit them only through an explicit handoff from the owning track.
src/hooks/useViewportProxiedLayers.ts and coverage/snapshot reader files pass from reader r2 to conformity c2 only after the production zoom/availability/request contract is frozen.
The availability schema/publisher remains owned by gapless p0a until its artifact contract and bootstrap are complete.
interface/cli/, parquet_ops/, and pyproject.toml pass from shrink s2a only after its completed tree is frozen; conformity must not touch delegated s2b direct-writer work.
Drizzle remains owned by shrink s6; conformity c4 may write only its own dormant-migration evidence manifest.
tripwires: Remove the fabricated moderation score before any broader cosmetic cleanup.
No file or dependency is deleted from a static reference scan alone.
No legacy writer or Railway service is disabled before the existing no-overlap handoff gate passes.
Drizzle and Alembic migration/history evidence is never treated as ordinary dead code.
Apply all accepted fixes before one integrated final sweep and independent review.

slices.task: Remove the fabricated causal-effect scorecard from consequential moderation controls; add a refusal/absence presentation until a provenance-carrying evaluated result exists.

Make conformity executable: add TypeScript unused-symbol coverage, extend Python typing to operator scripts, add thin-adapter/import-lattice checks, and require a locked Python format/lint/type/test receipt before deploy.

Restore canonical boundaries: extract CLI workflow/framework logic, consolidate governed snapshot-builder receipt/finalization machinery, split snapshot product validation/read responsibilities, and derive wire/schema columns from one descriptor.
Remove only proven orphans and dependencies; quarantine contingent candidates behind route/import/build/runtime proof, and leave migration files under shrink-track authority.

Reconcile topology documentation and tracked TODO/deprecation state, record dormant-migration state without editing Drizzle, run the single integrated frontend/Python/build sweep, obtain independent review, and publish exact removal and retained-candidate evidence.
